title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 29 | The Mountain Temple | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
High in the mountains, Zen the Monk teaches the party inner focus before the Grand Raid. They pass the Temple Trial against the Stone Guardian and watch the sunrise together, ready for the final adventure.

0:00 The Long Climb
0:45 Zen the Monk
1:30 The Stone Guardian

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
